name: game-prototype
description: > Runs hypothesis-driven prototyping: one question per prototype, a falsifiable hypothesis, the cheapest fidelity that answers it (paper, simulation, agent-built throwaway), a time box, observed playtests and a kill-or-promote call. Use for "prototype", "proof of concept", "test this mechanic", "is this fun". Not for building a small shippable game (use game-vibe-code).
